Point the camera at a scene and tap Take Picture. Sight Buddy describes what it sees. Hold the mic button and ask follow-up questions about the same image. Swipe between features or use Previous and Next when button navigation is on.

Point the camera at text and tap Take Picture. The app reads the text aloud and you can ask follow-up questions with the mic. Use Back and Forward to skip through the reading. Hold Back to restart from the beginning. Hold Forward to pause or resume the reader.
Move the camera slowly. Sight Buddy names the most confident object it sees, with a short pause between announcements so speech stays clear.
Hold the mic and say what to find, for example \"keys\" or \"cup\". Directional sounds guide you left, right, up, down, or centre. Tap Browse Objects to pick from a list.
Point the camera at the scene. Sight Buddy reports whether lighting is bright, dim, or dark based on the camera image.
Point the camera at the colour you want identified. Sight Buddy speaks the colour name from the centre of the view.

To start again from the beginning, hold the back button. To pause the reader, hold the forward button. A short tap on back or forward skips about twenty characters. You can open this help any time with the Help button.
